title: A little disappointed
text:
A little disappointed. Some things I love about this unit:
•Comes fully assembled
•Lightweight
•Extremely maneuverable
• Bright guide light
•Side brushes
Some things I don't like:
•Doesn't suck up much pet hair
•Can't reach beater bar without dissembling bottom
•NO ATTACHMENTS, so all the corners and nooks are unreachable
•No retractable cord
•THE COST; for this amount of $, this vacuum should be FLAWLESS and really "suck"!

PERFECT FOR PETS: Works to reduce unwanted pet odors for a fresher feeling clean that lasts the life of the bag

description: The ORECK HEPA SWIVEL PET offers maximum maneuverability with SlimSwivel steering while delivering powerful performance. HEPA Media filtration traps 99. 97% of particles like pet dander, dust and mold spores, making it ideal for homes with pets. It offers 4X more capacity than your typical bagless vacuum, and the SaniSeal design locks in dirt during disposal so you don’t have to worry about all the dust particles going back into the air. This vacuum is perfect for all floor types in your home. Simply adjust your brush roll speed for carpet, hardwood, tile & more. Plus, the ultra-lightweight design makes going up and down the stairs a breeze, while its low profile and LED lights give you full visibility to messes under furniture.
